_meta.description: Heart event #5 for npc_kiery: The Protective Gift

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Jack. I made you something. It took three weeks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Kiery presents a hand-sewn garment with hidden protective panels]

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: The outer layer is salvaged silk. The inner lining is reinforced.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: It won't stop a blade. But it'll slow one.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I made it because I need you to be safe.

options.text: You put your heart into every stitch.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Every stitch. Literally. Three weeks of worrying about you.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Is that too much? It's too much, isn't it?

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: ...No. It's exactly the right amount. For someone I...

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: ...for someone I care about. Very much.
